body.name: \mathcal P_{a,\ell}
body.def: At depth \(\ell\), divide \([-1/2,5/4]\) for \(a=1,2\) and \([-3/2,0]\) for \(a=3\) into \(2^\ell\) cells of width \(h_{a,\ell}\), with the last cell right-closed; group atom intervals contained in one common cell and make every interval not contained in a single cell a singleton.
